blocks.text: With its richly rustic finish and textural mix, Havalance end table goes to town on modern farmhouse style. Distressed two-tone treatment blends weathered gray with vintage white for an utterly charming effect. Robust legs lend a hearty, substantial feel ready to withstand the test of time.

items.label: VINTAGE CASUAL END TABLE
items.value: Charm your space with a well-balanced touch of rustic elements. Finished with a lightly weathered gray top, this table is a lovely addition to your living room

items.label: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED
items.value: Made of pine wood, pine veneers and engineered wood in a two-tone distressed finish. Designed with a plank-effect top and a fixed shelf for storage

items.label: FARMHOUSE FLAIR
items.value: The plank styling create a modern farmhouse mood. Finished in easy-to-match white and gray, you're in for a big style upgrade

items.label: GREAT FOR SMALL SPACES
items.value: Small in size, but big on style. This small side table measures 24" W x 26" D x 24" H—great for flanking a sofa in your living room or in narrow spaces

items.label: EASY ASSEMBLY
items.value: Instructions, tools and hardware included. Matching coffee table available and sold separately
